items.expected: The final molecular explanation connects the independently calculated neutral and oxidized bond strengths to strong oxidation-induced C4–H weakening and greater susceptibility to activation. The source pair differs by about 43 kcal/mol, a derived interpretation rather than a third numerical target. Do not claim that BDE alone proves an H-transfer rate, unique catalyst role, full product cycle or absolute redox potential.
